limitations: Genotype of the 2D-gel spots is `not available` (not stated in the deposit); full text of the paper not available to check.

The three *_overloaded files are not mentioned in the PRIDE text (it says 72 spots); they are treated as additional in-gel digests, so their enrichment value is the neutral 'thylakoid fraction, in-gel digested'.
No comparison factor is defined: the only experimental variable (genotype) is known for 3 of 78 runs, so no factor value column is written.
Mass tolerances not stated: `not available`; each RAW is its own source (biological replicate 1).
